summary: Read the entire markdown conversion, including Appendices A-I, and checked all four estimates against the supplied 84-page arXiv v7 PDF. The numerical sources on PDF pp. 18, 20, 36, 47, 58, and 64 confirm the recorded effects, intervals, p-value bounds, and final analyzed participant counts. The counts belong to the logo-generation sample; unprinted pairwise totals, observation counts, arm statistics, and coefficient SEs correctly remain null. The design and scoring methods support with_ai, usefulness, automated_score, output, more_creative, immediate timing, outcome_with_ai=true, within_person=null, ai_design, and participant-based uncertainty. The 3.2% result and its [-5.6%, 12.1%] interval are printed for Revised relative to Verbatim; the extraction explicitly preserves this direction as a reported paper effect, rather than claiming it is a Verbatim-minus-Revised difference. The standardized robustness result uses the same participants and is correctly distinguished from a participant-level Cohen’s d. No additional eligible full-sample outcome or contrast was found. Fixed-target image replication, researcher replay decompositions, moderation analyses, input-prompt measures, self-reports, and illustrative or validation results are appropriately excluded under the scope rules.
